mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we have overcast skies and 60 degree temperatures at Verona Community Park, with a first quarter moon visible.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins September 23 with lane closures scheduled on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, while the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects on October 5.

There is plenty to do with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today, live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, and Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park also happening today.
On September 5, officers responded to a local viral trend known as the Dairy Dare where vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields.
Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
